claims.nodeLabel: USS Ronald Reagan Encounter and Logbook Tampering (2003-2004)
claims.sourceText: Dave Beaty, Sean Munger and Craig Labadie, The Debrief, 9 May 2022
claims.text: Multiple USS Ronald Reagan watchstanders observed a round, orange, self-luminous object hovering above the flight deck and pacing the ship; witnesses include Karol Olesiak, Derek Smith and Patrick Gokey.

title: Dave Beaty, Sean Munger and Craig Labadie, The Debrief, 9 May 2022
